lines: +# Tool-agent rollout loop: tool-call extraction fix
+The bug was in what `examples/tool_agent/agent_loop.py` handed to SGLang's tool-call detectors, and in
+three of those detectors themselves. The loop now extracts calls itself (`extract_tool_calls`), with the
+model's reasoning parser name passed from `launch/run_tool_agent.py` as `--generate-reasoning-parser`
+(falling back to `--sglang-reasoning-parser`). Samples, tokens, loss masks, final text and rewards are
+untouched: only which calls execute, and with what arguments, changed.
+Findings, per format:
+- All models: the loop parsed the whole generation, reasoning included, whereas the deploy server runs the
+  reasoning parser first. The loop now separates reasoning in the model's own terms (`<think>` blocks,
+  starting inside one when the generation prompt opened it; Harmony channels for gpt-oss), keeping the
+  implicit-reasoning-close call these models also emit.
+- `qwen3_coder`: its one-shot parser falls back to parsing a `<tool_call>` block that never closed, turns a
+  string argument `"null"` into `None`, and leaves `anyOf` arguments (e.g. `timeout: number|null`) as strings.
+- `glm47`: string arguments whose text parses as JSON/Python were re-encoded (`json.dumps` / `str`), losing
+  formatting and trailing newlines, and turning `true`/`null`/`1e3` into `True`/`None`/`1000.0`.
+- `gpt-oss`: SGLang's detector does not recognise the call header the model's chat template renders
+  (`assistant to=functions.* <|channel|>commentary json`), nor a call that opens the turn.
+- `qwen25` / `llama3`: finished calls were dropped over framing whitespace (a newline after `<tool_call>`,
+  leading whitespace before the JSON); truncated JSON is still rejected.
+XML-style values (GLM, Qwen3-Coder) carry no type, so they are now converted by the tool's schema
+(`anyOf`/`oneOf` included); a string argument keeps the model's exact text. JSON-style arguments keep their
+JSON values. A call counts only once its block/message terminator was written.
+Verification: `tests/test_tool_call_parsing.py` (stdlib unittest); template-rendered call round-trips for
+Qwen3.5-2B/4B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, GLM-4.7-Flash, gpt-oss-20b and Llama-3.1-8B on both agents;
+offline replay of all four recorded runs (GLM data differs from the old loop in exactly the 6 reported
+arguments, Qwen3 runs by the drafted/unfinished calls); and live batch run 1 (`/tmp/live/run-1`:
+128 SQL + 32 data rollouts, 0 errors).
